title: La mi la sol (de Orto)
desc: Marbrianus de Orto, La mi la sol. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ort3006); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
